title: Choosing a cost management tool

kcs.statement: Pick the cost tool by the question asked: the future cost of an unbuilt design → Pricing Calculator; an alert before overspending → AWS Budgets; what was spent and why → Cost Explorer.
When finance needs hourly, resource-level billing data in its own BI or SQL tools, the answer is the Cost and Usage Report rather than Cost Explorer.
To find waste, use Compute Optimizer for rightsizing over-provisioned compute and Trusted Advisor's cost optimization checks for idle resources such as unattached EBS volumes or idle load balancers.

problem_ideas: Match five requests (quote a design, alert at $1k, chart last quarter, hourly line items, oversized instances) to five tools.
A CFO asks 'what will we spend next month if trends continue?': which tool forecasts from actual usage?
A team keeps paying for EBS volumes from deleted instances: which tool surfaces them?
For each wrong answer in a sample question, say why Budgets, Cost Explorer or the calculator does not fit.
A company wants spend tracked per project and an alert per project: which two features combine?
A new architecture proposal needs a 3-year cost comparison with on-premises: tool and its limit.
